title: Ezra and the Dealing with Foreign Wives
description: While Ezra prays and confesses before the house of God, a large assembly gathers in bitter weeping. Shecaniah proposes making a covenant to send away the foreign wives and their children. Ezra makes the leaders swear an oath, and it is announced that all who have been in exile must gather in Jerusalem within three days. The people confess their sins, and an investigation is carried out over three months. Finally, the names of the priests, Levites, and other men who had taken foreign wives are recorded.
